description: Median yearly total pay in USD across levels over the last 12 months. Compare up to 5 locations. Example: {"jobFamilySlug":"software-engineer","locationSlugs":["united-states"]}. For pay by level at a company, use get-salaries-by-company-level. Never guess slugs. Use search-job-families, search-locations or search-companies. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, locationSlugs. Array-typed arguments (locationSlugs) must be passed as arrays, even for a single value.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

locationSlugs.description: City, metro, country or region. For states, use a metro or country.

name: get-salary-percentiles
